turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma from Lucknow?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Sharma speaking. Who is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My name is Ananya and I am calling from the fraud prevention team of your bank. We have noticed a very unusual transaction on your account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What do you mean? What has happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There is a pending request for one lakh rupees to a merchant in another state. Did you authorize this payment?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One lakh? No, no, I have not done any such transaction today!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I see. In that case, I am blocking your debit card immediately to prevent the money from leaving your account. Is that okay?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, please block it quickly. But will I lose my money?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry, the transaction was flagged and the card is now disabled. You should visit your branch for a replacement card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thank you. Do you need any details or a code from me to finish this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, Mr. Sharma. Please remember that we will never ask you for your OTP, PIN, or CVV over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am glad to hear that. I will go to the bank tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is the correct thing to do. Have a good day, sir.
